title: Catalytic aerobic oxidation of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural to 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid using Co–Mn/N–C catalysts in aqueous media
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00783F, Paper
Open Access

Shuolin Zhou, Sha Wen, Ying Liu, Xianxiang Liu
A novel non-noble metal catalyst (Co–Mn/N–C) was synthesized, and it demonstrated an excellent catalytic performance in the selective oxidation of HMF in aqueous media.
